request.prompt: Which humanoid robots can be purchased in Asia?

result.text:
Asia is currently one of the strongest markets for commercially available humanoid robots, particularly China. Several manufacturers offer robots for research, education, industrial testing, and increasingly general-purpose applications.

The important distinction is between:

Purchase-ready robots: Available for direct purchase or commercial orders.

Research robots: Available to universities, laboratories, and developers.

Industrial humanoids: Primarily sold to companies for pilot projects and factory deployment.

Here are the main manufacturers and models worth considering.

1. Chinese humanoid robots available to buy

Indicative prices in USD, November 2026. Actual prices depend on configuration, distributor and destination.

1. Unitree G1

Available to order

Manufacturer: Unitree Robotics, China

Height: approximately 132 cm

Price: approximately $13,500 and up

Application: AI research, robotics development, manipulation and education

One of the most accessible advanced humanoid platforms.

Purchase reference: .

2. Unitree R1

Available to order

Manufacturer: Unitree Robotics, China

Height: approximately 123 cm

Price: approximately $4,900–$5,900

Application: education, development and experimentation

A relatively affordable entry into full-body humanoid robotics.

3. EngineAI PM01

Commercial orders

Manufacturer: EngineAI, Shenzhen, China

Height: approximately 138–140 cm

Indicative reseller price: €18,824

Application: research, AI development and humanoid movement experiments.

Purchase reference: .

4. Fourier GR-1

Manufacturer: Fourier Intelligence, Shanghai, China

Height: approximately 165 cm

Indicative reseller price: €37,647

Application: rehabilitation research, human-robot interaction and research laboratories.

Purchase reference: .

5. Booster T1

Manufacturer: Booster Robotics, China

Height: approximately 118 cm

Indicative reseller price: €34,545

Application: robotics education, programming, research and robot competitions.

Purchase reference: .

Other Chinese manufacturers worth investigating:

AgiBot – A2 and Lingxi series.

LimX Dynamics – Oli and TRON.

UBTECH Robotics – Walker S series.

EngineAI – T800.

Dobot Robotics – Atom.

Some of these are sold through enterprise contracts rather than straightforward online checkout.

4. Where to purchase

The main purchasing channels are:

Unitree Robotics – Manufacturer and product ordering.

EngineAI – Shenzhen-based manufacturer.

Fourier Intelligence – Humanoid and rehabilitation robotics.

Booster Robotics – Educational and research humanoids.

AgiBot – Chinese humanoid robotics manufacturer.

For international orders, check shipping to your country, export restrictions, CE certification where applicable, warranty coverage, spare parts and software support.

5. My recommendation

If the objective is to acquire a working humanoid robot rather than simply invest in a demonstration model:

Under $10,000: Unitree R1.

$10,000–$20,000: Unitree G1.

$20,000–$40,000: EngineAI PM01 or Booster T1.

Above $40,000: Fourier GR-1 or larger industrial platforms.

One important question

What is your intended application?

Industrial use – factory work, logistics, assembly and material handling.

Research and development – AI, machine learning, robotics programming.

Commercial use – reception, customer service, hotels and exhibitions.

Personal use – home assistance and general-purpose humanoid robotics.

Investment or distribution – purchasing robots in Asia for resale in Europe.
